reason: The README describes a user-interface plugin centered on a right-side navigation sidebar for workspace files, Git status and actions, skills, editor views, and theme synchronization.

summaries.zh: 为 Deepseek Harness 工作区添加右侧侧边栏，提供文件浏览、编辑器、Git 状态与操作、技能查看及主题同步功能。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side Deepseek Harness workspace sidebar for file browsing, editor views, Git status and actions, skill inspection, and theme synchronization.

capabilities: Adds a right-side workspace sidebar with Explorer, Git, Skills, and Editor tabs
Displays workspace folders and file contents
Tracks Git changes and supports staging, committing, discarding changes, and viewing history
Displays loaded skills, their status, content, and referenced files
Synchronizes light and dark mode and supports plugin configuration
